_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Arcane cast, written to the Powder sample (ground.json). [MM-story_mwohmiyq_2u]

water.why: Ferryman Brack sells him drowned ledgers, honestly.

secrets.text: He wants Ash Basalt, for shelves that will not burn.
secrets.line: Ash Basalt. For shelves Mordane can't burn.

secrets.text: He can tell a forged page by touch. A lie feels warm.
secrets.line: This page is warm. Someone lied in it.

secrets.text: He'll copy any record for anyone, by the terms as written.
secrets.line: Terms as written: bring the paper, take a copy.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Ash Basalt to the Archive.

secrets.text: He hates fire. All of it, holy or not.
secrets.line: Fire is fire, whatever it prays to.

secrets.text: The one record he hid: Mordane and Isolde share a mother.
secrets.line: One record I hid. Mordane and Isolde share a mother.

mission.task: Recover the birth registry from the burned annex on Cinder map 1.

secrets.text: He wants one honest history, with nobody's name on the cover.
secrets.line: One honest history. Nobody's name on it.

secrets.text: He has loved Hierophant Aurelia for forty years, and filed every sermon twice.
secrets.line: Forty years I've filed Aurelia's sermons. Each one twice.

secrets.text: He filed the warrant that sent his own apprentice to the pyre.
secrets.line: I filed the warrant that burned my apprentice.

secrets.text: What he writes in the ledger cannot be unwritten, not even by the Choir.
secrets.line: What I write, even the Choir can't unwrite.

mission.task: Keep the record: win three Cinder maps in a row.

lines.start: Welcome to the club, unbeliever. No dress code.
lines.win: Ha! Clean getaway. Nobody recited anything.
lines.lose: They got your walls. Heretics always rebuild.

secrets.text: Any flame she lights refuses to burn a prisoner.
secrets.line: My fire won't burn anyone in chains. Handy.

mission.task: Light the way: build four towers before wave 1 ends on Cinder.

secrets.text: She hears a lie as a wrong note, like a choir singing flat.
secrets.line: Somebody's flat. Somebody's lying.

secrets.text: She hates Inquisitor Mordane's pyres, and misses the brother inside him.
secrets.line: Mordane burns people. He used to braid my hair.

secrets.text: She loves Corsair Finn Saltmoor of the Water, the enemy. She burned his sails; he proposed.
secrets.line: I set a pirate's sails on fire. He proposed.

secrets.text: She shares smuggled pamphlets with anyone who'll read one aloud.
secrets.line: Read one out loud, and the pamphlets are yours.

mission.task: Spread the word: finish a Cinder map without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: She wants Duskmoss Resin. It makes an ink the Inquisition can't bleach.
secrets.line: Duskmoss Resin. Ink they can't bleach. Please?

secrets.text: She wants a church with no doors, so nobody can be shut out.
secrets.line: A church with no doors. Imagine.

secrets.text: Aurelia's first sermon, on freedom, hidden before Aurelia banned it.
secrets.line: Aurelia preached freedom once. I hid the proof.

mission.task: Recover the banned sermon from the old chapel on Cinder map 6.

secrets.text: Aurelia raised her as a daughter, and still signed her warrant.
secrets.line: Aurelia raised me. Then she signed my warrant.

characters.name: Acolyte-Scholar Wen
characters.againstTypeWhy: The faith answers questions by burning them. Its youngest scholar keeps asking.

hightech.why: She writes to Dr. Grace Sterling about ethics.

lines.start: Let's reason this through, unbeliever. Gently.
lines.win: Clean. The practice held, so the scripture holds.
lines.lose: You fought well. It wasn't enough. That's all.

secrets.text: Her first library burned on Mordane's sentence. She saved one book.
secrets.line: I saved one book from the fire. One.

secrets.text: She lends her notes to any commander who'll argue with them.
secrets.line: Argue with my notes, and you can keep them.

mission.task: Win Cinder map 3 at three stars.

secrets.text: She loves Lightbearer Cassian, who carries the flame and will hold nothing else.
secrets.line: Cassian holds the flame. Never my hand.

secrets.text: She wants Phoenix Glass. Through it, burned pages can be read.
secrets.line: Phoenix Glass reads ash. Bring me some.

secrets.twist: The girl hates me because I burned the lies she was copying.
secrets.text: She hates Inquisitor Mordane, who burns books to save time.
secrets.line: Mordane burns books. He calls it editing.

secrets.text: Once a day, any question she asks aloud gets an honest answer.
secrets.line: One question a day. Someone always answers true.

mission.task: Deliver 10 Ember Obsidian to her study.

secrets.text: She feels a wrong idea nearby as a headache behind the eyes.
secrets.line: My head aches. Somebody nearby is wrong.

secrets.text: She wants doctrine rewritten as a map, not a wall.
secrets.line: Doctrine should be a map, not a wall.

secrets.text: The book she saved: the first scripture, with Isolde's notes in the margins.
secrets.line: My saved book has Isolde's notes in it.

mission.task: Carry her book to the hidden school on Cinder map 3.

water.why: He hid Chieftain Coral's children from Drowned Kael.

lines.start: Behind me, faithful. Come no further.
lines.win: Held. The flock is safe. Thank the Light.
lines.lose: You were someone's charge too. I'm sorry.

secrets.text: He'll share the altar's bread with anyone who shields the flock.
secrets.line: Shield the flock, and share our bread.

mission.task: Finish a Cinder map with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: He hates the throne the Prime has built on the altar.
secrets.line: The throne can wait. The people cannot.

secrets.text: He feels a frightened child within a mile, like a draught on a candle.
secrets.line: Somebody small is frightened. My flame bends.

secrets.text: He wants Loam Grain, to feed the refugees behind his altar.
secrets.line: Loam Grain. The refugees ate the last today.

secrets.text: He wants to leave the Church and simply feed people.
secrets.line: I'd leave the Church just to feed people.

secrets.text: He loves Acolyte-Scholar Wen. His vows say no.
secrets.line: Wen argues with me. I'd marry her for it.

secrets.text: His flame cannot be bought. It goes out in any hand that pays for it.
secrets.line: My flame goes out if you pay for it.

mission.task: Carry the flame: win Cinder map 4 without losing a wall.

secrets.text: He hid Chieftain Coral's children in the catacombs, against the Prime's law.
secrets.line: Coral's children are in the catacombs. Help me.

mission.task: Escort the Reef-Born children out on Cinder map 4.

secrets.text: He once held the light while Mordane lit a pyre.
secrets.line: I held the light for Mordane's pyre. Once.

water.why: Drowned Kael fences her stolen flame.

lines.start: Unbeliever! Finally. Bring your flame. I'm hungry.
lines.win: Aw. Spat out. I'll eat the next one.
lines.lose: Look at it all, steaming. Every last mouthful.

secrets.text: She wants Dreamspore. She eats dreams, and hers are getting thin.
secrets.line: Dreamspore, sweetling. I'm hungry for dreams.

secrets.text: There is no lesson. She just eats the tower.
secrets.line: No lesson. I just wanted the tower.

lie.text: She offers to teach you to eat flame, for one tower.
lie.line: Feed me one tower. I'll teach you fire.

mission.task: Win a Cinder map after losing a tower.

secrets.text: She loves Inquisitor Mordane, who has hunted her for ten years.
secrets.line: Mordane's hunted me for years. Best years ever.

lie.text: She says she loves only what she can swallow.
lie.line: Love? I love what I can swallow.

secrets.text: She can eat any spell cast at her, and grow from it.
secrets.line: Cast at me. Go on. I'm peckish.

mission.task: Eat the volley: destroy 60 enemies in one wave on Cinder.

secrets.text: The vault is empty. She needs someone else to break its seal.
secrets.line: The vault's empty. I just needed the seal broken.

lie.text: She says the vault under the cathedral holds the Hierophant's gold.
lie.line: Gold under the cathedral, sweetling. Go dig.

mission.task: Break the vault seal on Cinder map 5.

secrets.text: She hates Aurelia's pity more than Mordane's fire.
secrets.line: Pity's worse than fire. Aurelia drips with it.

secrets.text: She can taste power in a room, sweet or sour.
secrets.line: Mmm. Someone here tastes sour. You?

secrets.text: She wants to eat the Heartflame and become the altar.
secrets.line: Eat the Heartflame. Become the altar. Lovely.

secrets.text: She was an acolyte who could not light a candle. They laughed.
secrets.line: I couldn't light a candle. They laughed. Now look.

water.why: She and Tide-Priestess Marena both pray for balance.

lines.start: Be at peace, unbeliever. Hold still.
lines.lose: Even heresy is gathered home. Rest now.

secrets.text: She feels a lost soul as a cold spot in the Light.
secrets.line: There's a cold spot in the Light. You?

secrets.text: She gives the altar's grace to anyone who asks without fear.
secrets.line: Ask without fear, and grace is given.

mission.task: Finish an Arcane mission without breaking it.

secrets.text: She wants Heartflame, to relight the first altar.
secrets.line: Heartflame. The first altar has gone dark.

secrets.text: Anyone she forgives sleeps without nightmares, once.
secrets.line: I forgive you. Sleep well tonight. Truly.

mission.task: Win Cinder map 6 with no wave reaching the base.

secrets.twist: She hates the fire because it does what her mercy never dares.
secrets.text: She hates what Mordane made of mercy: a pyre with a prayer on it.
secrets.line: Mordane put a prayer on a pyre. I hate it.

secrets.text: She wants to tear up Isolde's warrant, and cannot without breaking the Law.
secrets.line: I want to tear up a warrant. The Law forbids.

secrets.text: Her own first sermon, on freedom, which she later banned.
secrets.line: I preached freedom once. Then I banned it.

mission.task: Recover her first sermon from the old chapel on Cinder map 6.

secrets.text: She loves Heretic Isolde, the novice she raised as a daughter.
secrets.line: Isolde was mine to raise. She still is.

secrets.text: She signed Isolde's warrant to keep the schism from becoming a war.
secrets.line: I signed my daughter's warrant. To prevent a war.

dark.why: The Hollow Prophet stole his first congregation.

lines.win: You slipped the pyre. I add it to the sentence.
lines.lose: You were an error. I was the correction.

secrets.text: He hates the Hollow Prophet, who stole his first congregation.
secrets.line: The Hollow Prophet stole my first flock.

secrets.text: He pays the Church's bounty for any heretic's name.
secrets.line: A heretic's name earns a bounty. Speak.

mission.task: Hunt doubt: destroy 50 enemies in one wave on Cinder.

secrets.text: He wants Ember Obsidian: pyre stones that never cool.
secrets.line: Ember Obsidian. The pyres keep going out.

secrets.text: Isolde is his sister. He hunts her so that nobody crueler will.
secrets.line: Isolde's my sister. Better me than someone worse.

lie.text: He says he has no sister. The Church is his only family.
lie.line: Sister? The Church is my only family.

secrets.text: He smells doubt like smoke, even in himself.
secrets.line: I smell doubt. Some of it's mine.

secrets.text: A confession made to him is always true, whatever it costs.
secrets.line: Confess to me. You'll only manage the truth.

mission.task: Confess: finish three Arcane missions in a row.

secrets.text: He wants the Prime to order Isolde spared, so he can obey.
secrets.line: Order me to spare her. I'd obey. Gladly.

secrets.text: He burned his own teacher on the Prime's word, and tells himself he was right.
secrets.line: I burned my teacher. The Prime said I was right.

secrets.text: Isolde's childhood hair ribbon, kept in his prayer-book.
secrets.line: There's a ribbon in my prayer-book. Leave it.

mission.task: Recover his prayer-book from the burned cloister on Cinder map 7.

water.why: He respects Abyssal Sovereign Thal's kind of order.

lines.start: Rise not, unbeliever. The Law is closing.
lines.win: You tested the Law. I permit a moment's pride.
lines.lose: Precisely as ordained. The balance is holy.

secrets.text: The pardon is a pyre with better seating.
secrets.line: Pardon. Pyre. The words are cousins.

lie.text: He offers to pardon Isolde if you bring her to the altar.
lie.line: Bring me the heretic. I will pardon her.

mission.task: Win Cinder map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: His verdicts weigh exactly what they should. Nobody can lift one.
secrets.line: My verdicts weigh exactly right. Try lifting one.

mission.task: Bear the verdict: win a Cinder map without losing a wall.

secrets.text: He hates Mordane for presuming, and needs him anyway.
secrets.line: Mordane presumes. I keep him for that.

secrets.text: He wants a Void Lens, to see every sin at once.
secrets.line: A Void Lens. Sin is easier counted wholesale.

secrets.text: He wants Aurelia to abolish mercy herself, gently.
secrets.line: Aurelia will abolish mercy herself. I'll wait.

secrets.text: He feels the balance tip, like a scale in his chest.
secrets.line: The scale tipped. Someone here is unbalanced.

secrets.text: He loves Aurelia, and cannot forgive her for loving Isolde more.
secrets.line: Aurelia loves the heretic more than me.

lie.text: He says he and Aurelia disagree on nothing.
lie.line: Aurelia and I disagree on nothing that matters.

secrets.text: The schism's first decree, which names him as the one who started it.
secrets.line: The first schism decree has my name. Find it.

mission.task: Take the decree from the archive on Cinder map 8.

secrets.text: He was once as young and free as Isolde.
secrets.line: I was free once. Like her. It passed.

water.why: The Undertow is its silence under the sea.

lines.start: Unbeliever. Believer. Same noise. Be silent.
lines.win: You nearly made a sound. We nearly felt it.
lines.lose: Quiet now. Nothing left to hear. Good.

secrets.text: It hates Isolde's laughter. Laughter is a question.
secrets.line: The heretic laughs. Laughter is a question.

secrets.text: It hears thoughts as noise, and feels each one end.
secrets.line: So many thoughts here. Fewer now.

secrets.text: It wants Petal Silk, to stuff the cathedral bells.
secrets.line: Petal Silk. For the bells. Be silent.

secrets.text: Peace is erasure. Those who stop asking stop being.
secrets.line: Peace? You simply stop being. That is all.

lie.text: It offers peace to all who stop asking.
lie.line: Stop asking, and you will have peace.

mission.task: Win Cinder map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It loves The Undertow, a silence older than its own.
secrets.line: Below the sea, another silence. We love it.

secrets.text: Its last hymn, written down by Archivist Balthus before it fell silent.
secrets.line: Balthus wrote down our last hymn. Bring it.

mission.task: Take the hymn from the Archive on Cinder map 9.

secrets.text: It wants to finish unmaking itself, and almost dreads it.
secrets.line: We want to finish. We are almost afraid.

lie.text: It wants nothing. Wanting is a sound.
lie.line: We want nothing. Wanting is noise.

secrets.cost: Every silence costs it a voice. There are fewer singers each year, and it cannot remember their names.
secrets.reachWhy: The cloister knows where the silences fall. The novices count them.
secrets.text: Where it passes, sound stops for an hour.
secrets.line: We pass. Sound stops. Listen. Nothing.

mission.task: Hush the field: destroy 40 enemies in one wave on Cinder.

secrets.text: It was the cathedral choir. It sang at Mordane's first pyre, then chose silence.
secrets.line: We sang at the first pyre. Then we stopped.

secondary.name: Ferryman Old Brack
secondary.line: Ledgers for Balthus. Salt-stained. Fare's the fare.

secondary.name: Corsair Finn Saltmoor
secondary.line: Is Isolde burning something? Save me a seat.

secondary.name: Chief Ethicist Dr. Grace Sterling
secondary.line: Wen's last letter outargued my whole ethics board.

secondary.name: Chieftain Coral of the Reef-Born
secondary.line: Cassian kept my children safe. I owe him the sea.

secondary.name: Raider-Chief Drowned Kael
secondary.line: Nyx's stolen flame sells well. Burn more!

secondary.name: Tide-Priestess Marena
secondary.line: Aurelia prays to fire, I to water. Same balance.

secondary.name: The Hollow Prophet
secondary.line: Mordane's first flock listens to me now. Ask him.

secondary.name: Abyssal Sovereign Thal
secondary.line: Vaelith's Law and my weight. Both teach kneeling.

secondary.name: The Undertow (drowned collective)
secondary.line: Come down, Choir. The sea is quieter still.
